old: What is free here is the training loop, not tokens. Whether a new account still holds a starting balance is unverified: behind a sign-up. The promotion names one base model and excludes RL, DPO, full-parameter training, deployments and inference outside the training run, so it is not a general free-training lane. No cap on the number of free jobs is published; the concurrency cap is in limits.

old: serverless limits per model are tokens per minute, not requests: three adaptive meters (total prompt, uncached prompt and generated TPM) start at an unpublished default and rise 25% at most once every 15 minutes toward a ceiling set by model size and spend tier.
